title: The Emergence of Lab-Driven Alignment Signatures: A Psychometric Framework for Auditing Latent Bias and Compounding Risk in Generative AI
findings: The paper presents no findings related to religion as it was not a subject of the analysis.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on psychometric auditing of behavioral signatures such as Optimization Bias, Sycophancy, Status-Quo Legitimization, and Artificial Moderation.
